fields.climate: tropical; hot, humid; summer rainy season (May to December); winter dry season (December to April)
fields.terrain: coastal belt of mangrove swamps, wooded hill country, upland plateau, mountains in east
fields.hazards: dry, sand-laden harmattan winds blow from the Sahara (December to February); sandstorms, dust storms
fields.resources: diamonds, titanium ore, bauxite, iron ore, gold, chromite
fields.farm: cassava, rice, oil palm fruit, vegetables, sweet potatoes, milk, citrus fruits, fruits, groundnuts, sugarcane
fields.exports: iron ore, titanium ore, diamonds, aluminum ore, cocoa beans
fields.industries: diamond mining; iron ore, rutile and bauxite mining; small-scale manufacturing (beverages, textiles, footwear)
fields.languages: English (official, regular use limited to literate minority), Mende (principal vernacular in the south), Temne (principal vernacular in the north), Krio (English-based Creole, spoken by the…
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law and customary law
fields.military: 18-25 for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
